title: affected.py finds a map for the same commit in another worktree
lead: When the worktree's own map is missing, `tests/affected.py` looks for a map recorded for the same HEAD in the other worktrees of the repository and uses it, so a fresh slice worktree can select tests at once.
findings_note: v1.11 relay 2026-10-15: every new slice worktree starts with no `.venv/affected-map.json`, so `affected.py --run` exits 2 until a six-minute full discover runs there, even when the main checkout already holds a map for the same HEAD; s276, s282, s286, s271, s283 and s284 implementers all hit it
boundary: **Not in this slice:** sharing a map across different commits, writing to another worktree's `.venv`, and changing how a map is recorded.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A slice worktree is cut from `main`, so its HEAD equals the commit the main checkout's last full discover mapped. The map is keyed by SHA (`load_map`), so a map from another checkout at the same HEAD is exactly as valid. Today each new worktree pays a full discover first, which AGENTS.md now says in its Commands section.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `tests/affected.py`: in `select`, when `DEFAULT_MAP` is missing and no `--map` was given, list the other worktrees (`git worktree list --porcelain`, read-only) and use the first `<worktree>/.venv/affected-map.json` whose recorded SHA equals HEAD. Print one line on stderr naming the map it used. A map for another SHA is ignored as today. It never writes there.
- `tests/test_affected.py`, `AGENTS.md` (the fresh-worktree sentence), `CHANGELOG.md`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests with a two-worktree git fixture and watch them go red.
2. Add the lookup.
3. Update AGENTS.md and CHANGELOG. Mutation-check each new test.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The full suite passes; `slicer check` passes.
- In a new worktree cut from a mapped `main`, `python3 tests/affected.py --run` runs the selected tests without a full discover first.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/s288`, branch `feature/s288-affected-sibling-map`. Commit only on the branch.
